_comment: Declarative chat accounts, rendered into the profile's user.js by
bin/omarchy-thunderbird-apply. Accounts live in the messenger.account.<key>.*
namespace (imAccounts.sys.mjs), and account options such as the nickname sit one
level deeper under options.* (the account setters prefix every option with it).
Only credential-free accounts can be declared: a password is not a preference, it
goes to the system login store, so protocols that need one (Matrix, XMPP) still
have to be added in Thunderbird's own Chat tab. IRC needs no password
(passwordOptional), so it can be provisioned here.
key        identifier used in the pref names ([a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]*)
name       display name shown in the Chat tab
username   optional; for IRC the nick, or nick@server
